exposure: leaving hospital postpartum without initiating any contraception
initiation of a LARC method by 8 weeks postpartum
cohort: The study included 340 first-time adolescent mothers aged 19 or younger.
finding: Adolescent mothers who initiate a LARC method within 8 weeks of delivery are less likely to have a repeat pregnancy within 2 years compared to those who choose other methods or no method.
